snippet.title: Space Adventures : Mercury | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Space Adventures: Mercury 

Stranded on the least vacation-friendly planet in the solar system, you play as a slightly underprepared astronaut on a mission to fix your busted spacecraft. Easy, right? Just find 30 missing parts scattered across pits, crumbling platforms, and aggressive alien critters who clearly don’t like visitors.

Dodge danger, collect parts, and try not to spontaneously combust from the heat – all in a day’s work for the galaxy’s most unlucky explorer.

Fix your ship. Escape the madness. And maybe – just maybe – live to see Venus.
